forecast_context.Minutes sensitivity: Unavailable; missing appearances are not assigned zero minutes
forecast_context.Absence scenario status: Research only; not applied to the pick. Quoted-player/reference history may omit teammates.

Minutes restriction check.Status: No explicit current minutes-limit report found in checked injury feed

Verified schedule context.Method: Pacific calendar dates and verified NBA schedules, including preseason and playoffs for rest context; off days are schedule gaps, not verified days of physical rest. No automatic rest or travel penalty.

Teammate absence usage.Source: Explicit played/DNP box-score flags; missing roster rows excluded

Opponent and pace context.Status: Research context; no player-level or position-specific multiplier applied
Opponent and pace context.Method: Estimated possessions: FGA − offensive rebounds + total turnovers + 0.44 × FTA; average both teams, normalize overtime. Recent verified final regular-season games only.

forecast_context.NBA context limitation: Historical associations and estimated pace are not validated causal/player multipliers; they do not change the base projection or probability.
forecast_context.Player averages method: Observed regular-season appearances before game date. Last-5/10 may span seasons or teams as labeled. Shooting percentages use total paired makes/attempts. Historical line results are descriptive, not forecast probabilities.

NBA role usage.Status: Current starting/bench role unconfirmed; no role-specific minutes assumed
NBA role usage.Method: Same-team explicit historical starter/bench flags, up to 12 observed regular-season appearances. Matching-role median minutes; candidate stat holds base production per minute unchanged. Role scenarios are not validated forecasts or separate picks.

forecast_context.NBA role status: Current starting/bench role unconfirmed; no role-specific minutes assumed

Game-day diagnostic.interpretation: Counts are reported as measured; software tests and historical games are different. Correlated props are not independent games. Diagnostics do not guarantee a winning bet.

paired_forecast.scope: Frozen unadjusted base versus actually issued forecast; not hypothetical candidate

records.record_purpose: Analyzed forecast only; excluded from official pick results
